front.title: Source-IP-Community Filter for BGP Flow Specification

abstract.t: BGP Flow Specification Version 2 (FSv2) propagates traffic Flow Specifications and Traffic Filtering Actions using an extensible TLV- based filter family architecture. This document specifies a new FSv2 component type under the Routing Filter Family to support community- level filtering within a single administrative domain. The match condition filters traffic based on the BGP Community attributes associated with the route matching the packet's source IP address.
